kaggle_version_metadata: Version inferred from the KaggleHub versioned cache path; public Kaggle dataset metadata reported version 2, updated 2026-09-16 at retrieval.
dataset_cache_location: KaggleHub-managed cache; local absolute path intentionally omitted
language_distribution: Unavailable: source schema contains no language field; no language detector was run.
selection_rule: curated Agentic Web phrase in title OR body (at least one hit); agent-related tags are metadata only

selection_evaluation.note: No manual labels were supplied; precision/recall are not reported.

representation.lemmatization_scope: topic view only; vocabulary-level, one-word context; NER/stored text unchanged

topic_model.selected_n_topics_rationale: K=3 most reproducible across resamples (see topic_stability_summary.csv); NPMI alone would favour larger K

relation_semantics: MENTIONED_WITH co-occurrence is separate from unreviewed directed lexical-template claim candidates; neither is treated as validated real-world fact.

semantic_claim_extraction.method: typed lexical templates over adjacent same-sentence entity mentions
semantic_claim_extraction.event_time: not extracted; null in every candidate
semantic_claim_extraction.manual_review: unreviewed candidates; blank annotations in outputs/evaluations/relation_review.csv
semantic_claim_extraction.evidence_offset_basis: title + newline + first 2,500 characters of text_clean
semantic_claim_extraction.graph_reload_checks: performed in notebook artifact round-trip cell

entity_resolution_status: Domain lexicon aliases are linked to canonical IDs; spaCy-only mentions retain surface-form IDs and are not disambiguated or assigned NIL.
confidence_policy: Entity/relation confidence is left null because neither spaCy entity scores nor calibrated relation probabilities are available.
graph_type: undirected NetworkX Graph for co-occurrence; separate directed MultiDiGraph for unreviewed semantic claim candidates

layers.layer: Entity inventory (all normalized entity IDs; nodes of both GraphML files)
Co-occurrence graph: nodes with >=1 co-occurrence edge

layers.status: entity never shares a sentence with another extracted entity

layers.layer: Directed semantic candidates: nodes with >=1 candidate edge
Directed semantic candidates: isolated nodes (inventory entities with no candidate)

llm_extraction_pilot.sampling: fixed seed 20261011; 25 with and 25 without template candidates
llm_extraction_pilot.input: title + first 2,500 characters (same as the NER input)
llm_extraction_pilot.validation: grounding only (aligned span names both entities, predicate in schema); accuracy not measured

authorship_and_ai_disclosure.ai_disclosure: GitHub Copilot and AI language models drafted the code for Stage 1; the student directed the project and is responsible for reviewing results, interpreting findings and documenting limitations; AI tools were also used for debugging and documentation.
